items.title: 집 묘사
items.question: You indicated in your background survey that you live in an apartment. Tell me about your home. What does it look like? What types of rooms does it have?
script: I live in a small studio apartment in downtown Seoul. It's located in the center of Seoul.

Actually, I don't have a bedroom in my apartment because it's a small studio. But it has nice bathroom and a big kitchen area. My apartment is very clean and modern, so I really like my place. What makes my apartment special is a big window. Whenever I open it, I can get some fresh air. Also, the window lets in a lot of light, and that makes my studio super bright and cheerful.
So, anyway, my home is the best place for me to relax and chill out. I know my studio is very small, but it's cozy and comfortable.
keywords: 특별한 점: 큰 창문 → 열면 fresh air
햇빛 많이 들어옴 → bright and cheerful
마무리: relax and chill out · 작지만 cozy and comfortable
